title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty term to the loss function. This penalty term is controlled by the parameter lambda (λ).

title: Effect of Lambda on Errors
text: As lambda increases, the model complexity decreases, which can affect both training and validation errors. Consider how these errors change with different values of lambda.

title: Identifying Training and Validation Errors
text: Training error typically decreases with increasing model complexity, while validation error decreases up to a point and then increases due to overfitting. Which plot shows this behavior?

hintAnswer: The error decreases initially and then increases.
title: Analyzing Plot B
text: Look at Plot B. How does the error change as lambda increases?
choices: The error decreases initially and then increases.
The error increases initially and then decreases.
